A four-edge obstruction to submodular separation of quadratic Boolean monomial images: a counterexample to Brakensiek-Gopi-Guruswami Conjecture 3.33 (arXiv:1902.04740; ECCC TR19-013)

Myeongjin Kang

Abstract

Conjecture 3.33 is false at (r,d) = (2,5): no integer- (indeed real-) valued submodular function on {0,1}^16 is negative exactly on the degree-2 monomial image of {0,1}^5.
